name: humagent
description: Work with your AI agent through pages, prototypes, and local apps.

scripts.lint: bunx --bun --no-install oxlint src web scripts test
scripts.format: bunx --bun --no-install oxfmt src web test scripts tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.format:check: bunx --bun --no-install oxfmt --check src web test scripts tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.test:browser: bun run build && playwright test --config test/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.check:release: bun run check && bun run test:browser && bun pm pack && bun run test:package && bun run test:install && bun run test:runners

author: Georgii Bukharov
